title: The 2008 Non-Prosecution Agreement
summary: Facing a 53-page federal indictment, Epstein's team negotiated an NPA with U.S. Attorney Acosta's office. He pleaded to two Florida state charges, served ~13 months of an 18-month county-jail sentence with work release, and the NPA immunized him, four named accomplices and unnamed 'any potential co-conspirators' from federal prosecution in S.D. Florida. Victims were not informed (later found to violate the Crime Victims' Rights Act). DOJ's OPR called it 'extraordinary' and found 'poor judgment,' no impermissible considerations.
